about_the_game:
<h2> Horror Companion Archetypes</h2>
<p> 36 full-color archetype cards. Each 3.5x5 card features a ready-to-play character, ideal for convention games, pick-up games, or store play.</p>
<p>
<b> Modern Horror Archetypes</b>
</p>
<ul> <li> Survivor, Nerd, Jock, Ghost Hunter, Exorcist, Psychic, Gamer, Party Animal, Witch, Runner, Occultist, Doctor</li>
</ul> <p>
<b> Pulp Horror Archetypes</b>
</p>
<ul> <li> Explorer, Soldier, Gumshoe, Socialite, Magician, Librarian</li>
</ul> <p>
<b> Gaslight Horror Archetypes</b>
</p>
<ul> <li> Constable, Journalist, Aristocrat, Burglar, Sailor, Mambo</li>
</ul> <p>
<b> Monstrous Archetypes</b>
</p>
<ul> <li> Angel, Demon, Mummy, Patchwork Man, Phantom, Revenant, Vampire, Werewolf, Demonologist, Slayer, Nemesis, Swamp Freak</li>
</ul> <p> </p>
<p> To be used with the Horror Companion and the Savage Worlds Adventure Edition core rules.</p> "
